notes: This portable C++ TCK scenario uses only the IEEE 1516.1 API. An adapter supplies the multi-attribute FOM containing the configured object class and attributes, provider library, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation. The test's FOM fixture declares HLAreliable and HLAbestEffort on separate attributes; a provider adapter may supply equivalent names through the TCK options. The test sends one timestamped update to a non-time-constrained subscriber, checks the two reflected passels and their shared retraction designator, then verifies one recipient-local Request Retraction callback after Retract. The contract is limited to these observed outcomes and is not a conformance claim.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped Update Attribute Values and Retract, and FederateAmbassador reflection/Request Retraction callbacks
